svg.title: Toyota B Harness, stock v3
svg.desc: Editable vector reconstruction of the stock wiring drawing, not a modified TSS3 layout. Source: https://github.com/commaai/hardware/blob/eb44b589e6512519e14f0c3b370c5dfaf9b7df1e/harness/v3/Toyota_B_Harness.pdf (SHA-256: 39126557ad6ae4400dd0ac44080437e860cb3a6923a42b0ab523a78f456a8fb6). Labels are outlined to preserve type; individual outlined labels include their text in the object title. Original segment strokes are retained in paint order. SVG groups and data-wire attributes identify their conductors.
